name: Warrendale Gang
description: The Warrendale Gang was a historical neighborhood-based street gang active in the Warrendale district of Detroit, Michigan, primarily during the 1960s and into the early 1970s. Unlike Southwest Detroit gangs, members ranged in age from teens to their 30s and were largely car-based, with turf spread across multiple locations rather than concentrated on a single block. A notable associated group was Jan's Boys, who gathered at Joy Road and Evergreen near West Warren Avenue. Members attended Cody High School and partied at River Rouge Park. The scene shifted over time from fighting and drinking to drug use as heroin entered the neighborhood around 1967.
